DescribeImageModerationResult.title: DescribeImageModerationResult
DescribeImageModerationResult.summary: Retrieves the results of an Image Moderation Pro task.

DescribeImageResultExt.title: DescribeImageResultExt
DescribeImageResultExt.summary: The enhanced image moderation auxiliary information API operation retrieves additional auxiliary information detected by the enhanced image moderation API operation, including OCR results and custom image library hit information.

DescribeMultimodalModerationResult.title: DescribeMultimodalModerationResult
DescribeMultimodalModerationResult.summary: Query the results of an asynchronous multimodal moderation task.

DescribeUrlModerationResult.title: DescribeUrlModerationResult
DescribeUrlModerationResult.summary: Queries moderation results based on the ReqId returned by asynchronous URL moderation.

ImageAsyncModeration.title: ImageAsyncModeration
ImageAsyncModeration.summary: This API is used for asynchronous image moderation. Asynchronous moderation tasks do not return detection results in real time. You can obtain the detection results using a callback or by polling. The detection results are retained for up to three days.

ManualCallback.title: Manual Review Channel Callback Interface
ManualCallback.summary: The channel callback API for manual review results in Content Moderation.

ManualModeration.title: ManualModeration
ManualModeration.summary: Interface for submitting Content Moderation manual review requests

ManualModerationResult.title: Get content moderation manual review result
ManualModerationResult.summary: Retrieves the manual review result for content moderation.

MultiModalAgent.title: Content moderation agent
MultiModalAgent.summary: Synchronously detects content by calling the multimodal Agent API.

MultiModalAgentSSE.title: Content moderation agent streaming interface
MultiModalAgentSSE.summary: Synchronously moderates multimodal content through the Agent API.

MultiModalGuardAsync.title: MultiModalGuardAsync
MultiModalGuardAsync.summary: An asynchronous multimodal AI safety guardrail API for audio and video. It provides comprehensive detection of non-compliant content, sensitive content, prompt injection attacks, malicious files, and malicious URLs.

MultiModalGuardAsyncResult.title: Query AI safety guardrail multimodal asynchronous moderation results
MultiModalGuardAsyncResult.summary: Queries the asynchronous results of AI safety guardrail multimodal content moderation, supporting audio and video modalities.

MultiModalGuardForBase64.title: Multimodal protection (Base64)
MultiModalGuardForBase64.summary: Performs synchronous multimodal content moderation. Supports image base64 strings.

MultiModalGuardWs.title: AI safety guardrail multimodal detection webSocket API
MultiModalGuardWs.summary: Provides a WebSocket-based multimodal detection API for AI safety guardrails. This API supports content compliance detection, sensitive content detection, prompt attack detection, malicious file detection, malicious URL detection, and other comprehensive detection capabilities.

TextModeration.title: TextModeration
TextModeration.summary: This service uses dynamic policies and models to defend against adversarial content. It provides moderation services for various business scenarios and detects different types of violations.

TextModerationPlus.title: TextModerationPlus
TextModerationPlus.summary: Text Moderation Plus is an upgraded service that moderates the input instructions and generated text of large language models (LLMs). This service can retrieve standard answers for specific input instructions and lets you enable or disable moderation labels.

UrlAsyncModeration.title: UrlAsyncModeration
UrlAsyncModeration.summary: The URL asynchronous moderation service detects threats such as fraud, pornography, and gambling in URLs to protect the content ecosystem of your platform.

VideoModeration.title: VideoModeration
VideoModeration.summary: The enhanced video moderation feature of Content Moderation detects threats and non-compliant content in video files. Use this operation to submit a moderation task.

VideoModerationCancel.title: Cancel an ApsaraVideo Live content moderation node
VideoModerationCancel.summary: Cancels an ApsaraVideo Live content moderation node.

VideoModerationResult.title: Query video moderation task results
VideoModerationResult.summary: Retrieves the task result of a video moderation node from the enhanced video moderation service.

VoiceModeration.title: VoiceModeration
VoiceModeration.summary: Submits a task for enhanced voice moderation.

VoiceModerationCancel.title: VoiceModerationCancel
VoiceModerationCancel.summary: This operation cancels an enhanced voice moderation task.

VoiceModerationResult.title: VoiceModerationResult
VoiceModerationResult.summary: Retrieve the detection results for enhanced voice moderation.
